purpose: Fetch complete public source artifacts, pin their bytes, then run ppi_references. No gene list or selected study query is needed.

canonical_human_FASTA.reproduction_rule: Retain the pinned release artifact or recover that exact official release; refuse a changed current FASTA. Do not silently substitute a later release.

Negatome_manual_sources.archive_license_observed: CC-BY-4.0 for the author archive; this does not establish rights to redistribute all upstream contents.
Negatome_manual_sources.established_member_reader: remotezip==0.12.3; uses standard zipfile CRC checks and HTTP Range. It was used for capture, not imported by preparation.

scope_cautions: Native author labels are retained. Do not reconstruct a new curation algorithm from the paper.
Exact canonical physical labels and manual protein-pair assay labels are separate profiles.
Non-interaction is assay/state-dependent. It does not make a general functional annotation false.
No absent database record or unknown source row is negative gold.
Raw reference data and upstream author code are not included in this repository increment.
